The goal of this website is to (a) indulge my personal affinity for visualizing data and (b) learn a couple of new tools: Git, and RMarkdown websites. And (c) geek out on birds. 

``` {r checklistMaps, echo=FALSE,include=FALSE}
myeb.spatial <- sf::st_as_sf(
  myeb,
  coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = 4269,        # NAD83 lon/lat (EPSG:4269)
  remove = FALSE
)

countries <- sf::st_read("ne_110m_admin_0_countries.shp", quiet = TRUE)
land      <- sf::st_read("ne_110m_land.shp", quiet = TRUE)
box   <-matrix(c(-180,  90, 180,  90, 180, -90, -180, -90, -180,  90), byrow = TRUE, ncol = 2) %>%
    list()%>% sf::st_polygon() %>% sf::st_sfc(.,crs=4326)
grid <- sf::st_make_grid(box, n = c(18, 18), what = "polygons")
grid <- sf::st_sf(geometry = grid)   # make it an sf object for plotting

eck4 <- "+proj=eck4 +lon_0=0 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +ellps=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs"

myeb.spatial <- sf::st_transform(myeb.spatial, eck4)
land        <- sf::st_transform(land, eck4)
countries   <- sf::st_transform(countries, eck4)
grid        <- sf::st_transform(grid, eck4)



checklistsMap <- ggplot() +
  ggtitle("eBird checklists submitted") +
  geom_sf(data = grid,      fill="white", color=grey(0.4), linewidth=0.5) +
  geom_sf(data = grid,      fill="white", color=grey(0.7), linewidth=0.2) +
  geom_sf(data = countries, fill=grey(0.95), color=grey(0.4), linewidth=0.1) +
  geom_sf(data = land,      fill=NA, color="black", linewidth=0.25) +
  geom_sf(data = myeb.spatial, color = ebPal[4], alpha = 1/2, size = 3) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = figTitleSz)
  ) +
  coord_sf()
```

```{r display.map, include=TRUE,echo=FALSE}
checklistsMap
```
